_readme: The worked example's config: the first build (an SEO agency, Sep 21-22 2026) with its identifying details removed. Every GHL id is a placeholder or left out, so this file never touches a real account. It is valid for dry runs: node tools/ghl/build-structure.js --config examples/example-seo-agency/config.json --offline. A real client's config lives in clients/<CLIENT_SLUG>/config.json (never committed), copied from templates/client-config.json.

instantly._readme: The example runs cold email in Instantly, so workflow 1 is built. The webhook URL is the Inbound Webhook URL of 'Instantly - Interested Partner Reply'.

structure._readme: The example's changes to spec/structure.json: its 19 partner types, its 8 segment/ tags, one extra Lost Reason option, and the calendar slug and description.

calendar.description: A 20-minute intro call with a prospective referral partner for the Example SEO Partner Program.

ids._readme: In a real build, survey.js --ids writes this block. The example keeps only the form ids, as placeholders; every other id of the first build is left out.
